h1: Nursing staffing agencies: 10 firms sorted by how they actually fill shifts
seoTitle: Nursing Staffing Agencies: 10 Firms by Staffing Model (2026)
description: Ten nursing staffing agencies grouped by the job they do best: travel contracts, rapid response, per diem apps, franchise networks and international RN pipelines, with where each is based and what to check before you sign.
lead: A director of nursing with three open night shifts and a unit going on a 13 week census spike needs two different agencies, not one. This guide sorts nurse staffing firms by the model they run, so you call the right kind first.
shortAnswer: Short answer: for 13 week travel contracts at scale, start with Aya Healthcare. For a crisis opening or a labor action, Fastaff built the rapid response model. For per diem shifts in skilled nursing and post-acute settings, IntelyCare and Nursefinders are the first calls. If the gap is permanent and structural, the international pipelines at Avant and Conexus MedStaff take a year or more but end with your own employee.

choose.h: Name the model before the firm.
choose.p: Per diem fills a single shift, travel fills roughly a quarter, rapid response fills a gap that opens this week, and international recruitment fills a permanent seat on a long lead time. Most bad agency experiences come from buying one model to solve another.

Several firms below hold The Joint Commission's Health Care Staffing Services certification. Ask for the current letter rather than relying on a logo on the website, and ask how credential files are shared with your compliance team.

choose.h: Get the bill rate structure in writing.
choose.p: Ask whether the quote is an all-in hourly bill rate or a pay rate plus markup, what overtime and holiday multipliers apply, and whether there is a conversion fee if you hire the nurse permanently.

choose.h: Check who your account actually sits with.
choose.p: Several of these firms are now one brand inside a larger group. Ask which entity signs the contract, who handles escalations, and whether a vendor management system or a managed services program sits between you and the agency.

firms.name: Aya Healthcare
firms.model: Travel nursing, per diem app, workforce software
firms.bestFor: Large travel contracts plus the software to manage them
firms.summary: Aya describes itself as America's largest travel nursing and allied health staffing agency. Alongside travel contracts it sells workforce software to hospitals: the LotusOne vendor management system, a Workforce AI demand matching tool, an app-based Shifts product for per diem and float pool work, and CoreHire for permanent hiring.
good: You need many travel nurses across several units or sites
You want agency supply and a VMS from one vendor
watch: If Aya also runs your VMS, ask how other agencies are treated in the order queue
Large accounts get the most attention; small single unit orders may not

firms.name: Fastaff
firms.model: Rapid response travel nursing
firms.bestFor: Urgent openings that cannot wait for a normal travel start date
firms.summary: Fastaff was founded in 1989 and introduced what it calls the Rapid Response model: deploying experienced nurses quickly to hospitals facing urgent shortages, with guaranteed delivery and a focus on hard to fill specialties. It holds The Joint Commission's Gold Seal for staffing and is one of eight brands in the Ingenovis Health group, which also includes Trustaff, USN and VISTA Staffing.
good: A unit needs experienced nurses within days, not weeks
You want one group that can also cover longer travel and labor disruption needs
watch: Rapid response rates are a premium product; budget for it as an exception
Clarify which Ingenovis brand owns the order so escalations go to the right team

firms.name: IntelyCare
firms.model: App based per diem and part-time nursing
firms.bestFor: Skilled nursing and post-acute facilities filling shifts week to week
firms.summary: IntelyCare runs an app that matches nurses and nursing assistants to open shifts, and calls itself a healthcare talent platform rather than a traditional agency. In 2023 it moved to a regional structure and added full-time and part-time hiring alongside shifts. It holds The Joint Commission's Health Care Staffing Services certification.
good: Your gaps are individual shifts in long term care or post-acute settings
Schedulers want to post and fill shifts themselves
watch: Check coverage in your specific region before signing
An app fills shifts, it does not build unit continuity; pair it with a retention plan

firms.name: Nursefinders
firms.model: Per diem and local contract staffing
firms.bestFor: Local per diem coverage backed by a large parent
firms.summary: Nursefinders has placed nurses and allied professionals for more than 40 years and now focuses on per diem and local jobs in nursing, allied health and healthcare support. It is Joint Commission accredited and part of AMN Healthcare, which gives buyers a route into AMN's travel and workforce programs if needs grow.
good: You want local nurses who can pick up recurring shifts
You may later want travel or managed services from the same parent
watch: Local branch strength varies by metro; ask for fill rates in your market
Confirm whether orders route through an AMN program or directly

firms.name: Favorite Healthcare Staffing
firms.model: Per diem, local, travel and permanent placement
firms.bestFor: Facilities that want one vendor across every contract length
firms.summary: Favorite started placing travel nurses in 1991 and now offers per diem, local and travel assignments, temp to perm and direct hire, plus recruitment process outsourcing and a managed services program. It has held The Joint Commission certification since 2005 and says it has appeared on Staffing Industry Analysts' largest healthcare staffing firms list every year since 2009. It describes itself as part of a larger multinational group, with Espirita as its international sister company.
good: You want per diem and travel from one contract
You may outsource part of permanent nurse recruiting later
watch: Ask which parts of the group serve your account
Broad menus can mean thinner specialty depth; ask for references in your specialty

firms.name: ATC Healthcare
firms.model: Franchise network, per diem and contract
firms.bestFor: Local coverage from an owner operated office
firms.summary: ATC Healthcare has run a healthcare staffing franchise for close to 40 years, with locally owned offices across the United States. It serves hospitals, residential care programs, public health departments, school systems, medical groups and municipal governments.
good: You value a local owner you can call directly
Public sector and school nursing needs sit alongside hospital shifts
watch: Quality depends on the local franchise; meet the office that will serve you
Multi-state systems may deal with several franchise owners

firms.name: Gifted Healthcare
firms.model: Travel, local and per diem nursing
firms.bestFor: Gulf South facilities mixing contract lengths
firms.summary: Gifted Healthcare places nurses on travel assignments, local contracts and per diem shifts, and also covers allied health and education based roles such as school nursing and behavioral interventionists.
good: You need RNs, LPNs and CNAs across contract types
School and behavioral roles sit in the same budget as clinical nursing
watch: Confirm specialty depth for ICU, OR and L&D before relying on it
Ask for state by state fill history outside its home region

firms.name: Stability Healthcare
firms.model: Travel nursing and allied, permanent roles
firms.bestFor: Travel RN coverage from a smaller, clinician focused firm
firms.summary: Stability Healthcare places travel registered nurses and allied clinicians, lists permanent jobs alongside contracts, and runs a managed services offering for facilities. Its public job pages publish weekly pay ranges by state, which helps buyers sanity check the rates they are quoted.
good: You want a firm that publishes pay data openly
Med-surg, tele, ICU and ER travel needs
watch: Smaller bench than the national giants for very large orders
Ask how quickly it can credential for your state

firms.name: Avant Healthcare Professionals
firms.model: International nurse recruitment
firms.bestFor: Permanent RN seats filled from overseas
firms.summary: Avant has recruited internationally educated nurses for U.S. health systems for more than 20 years and is a member of the Jackson Healthcare family of companies. It holds The Joint Commission certification and stresses ethical recruitment practices that it says meet or exceed global standards.
good: Vacancies are structural and you can plan a year or more ahead
You want nurses who become long term members of your staff
watch: Immigration timelines are outside the agency's control
Read the commitment period and repayment terms that apply to nurses

firms.name: Conexus MedStaff
firms.model: International nurse recruitment
firms.bestFor: International pipelines with Philippines and UK teams
firms.summary: Conexus MedStaff was founded in Houston in 2011 and is led by CEO Andrew Moreton. It is family owned, with teams in the UK and the Philippines, and guides nurses through immigration, licensure and relocation into U.S. roles.
good: You want a second international pipeline alongside an incumbent
Relocation support matters for retention in your market
watch: Same lead time caveats as any international program
Ask how many nurses it currently has in the visa queue for your specialty

inhouse.h: When your own recruiting team should do it instead
p: Agency nurses solve a capacity problem, but every agency hour costs more than an employed hour, and none of it builds a bench. If the same units call an agency every quarter, the cheaper fix is usually a recruiting function that keeps a warm pipeline of local nurses: a CRM of past applicants and former staff, a scheduler that books interviews quickly, and outreach that reaches nurses on their phones.

Software can carry part of that load. Our high volume hiring stack covers the scheduling and screening side, and the sourcing tools category compares the search layer. Tools such as Noon's nurse sourcing workflow treat licensure as a hard filter and contact clinicians by email and SMS, which is how most nurses prefer to be reached between shifts.

Ask every firm on your shortlist to quote the same scenario: one night shift RN in your busiest unit for 13 weeks, and one per diem shift next Saturday. Comparing the two answers side by side shows you which firms are really travel shops and which are really local shops, regardless of what the website says.

Then ask what happens at week 14. A firm that only talks about extensions is selling continuity; a firm that offers a conversion path is selling you a hire. Both are fine, as long as you know which one you are buying. Our guide to applicant tracking systems covers how to keep agency and direct applicants in one record.

faq.q: What is the difference between a per diem and a travel nursing agency?
faq.a: A per diem agency fills individual shifts with nurses who live locally, often booked a few days ahead. A travel agency places a nurse on a fixed contract, commonly around 13 weeks, usually from outside your area.

faq.q: Do nursing staffing agencies need to be certified?
faq.a: Certification is voluntary, but many hospitals require it. The Joint Commission's Health Care Staffing Services certification is the most common; ask for the current letter during contracting.

faq.q: Can I hire an agency nurse permanently?
faq.a: Usually, but most contracts include a conversion fee or a minimum number of worked hours before conversion. Read that clause before the first shift, not after you want to make an offer.

faq.q: How do I list my staffing firm on this page?
faq.a: Use the listing details at the end of the guide. We review every request against the same criteria as the firms above.

h1: Staffing agencies in Dallas: 10 firms with a real office in the metroplex
seoTitle: Staffing Agencies in Dallas: 10 Firms With DFW Offices (2026)
description: Ten staffing agencies in Dallas with a verified office in the metro, from Noel Road and North Central Expressway to Plano, Irving and Garland, sorted by the kind of hire each handles best.
lead: Which Dallas staffing agency should you call? It depends less on the brand and more on the seat: a contract controller, a cybersecurity engineer and forty warehouse pickers are three different phone calls. Every firm below has a staffed office in the Dallas area, and we list the street so you know who is local.
shortAnswer: Short answer: for finance and office roles with a written guarantee, start with Frontline Source Group or Robert Half. For IT contractors at scale, TEKsystems and LaSalle Network. Clinical and revenue cycle roles go to Medix in Irving, and hourly warehouse or call center volume to Snelling. If you want a Texas owned firm, Choice Specialists is the Dallas arm of Burnett Specialists.

choose.h: Decide whether you are buying hours or a hire.
choose.p: Temporary and contract work is priced as an hourly bill rate; direct hire is priced as a fee on first year salary. Ask each firm to quote both for the same role, because the gap tells you how much the firm wants each kind of order.

choose.h: Ask which office will actually work the order.
choose.p: Several national firms serve Dallas from Plano or Irving. That is fine for remote friendly roles, but for on-site interviews or shift work you want the recruiter who knows the commute from Garland to the Stemmons corridor.

choose.h: Get the guarantee terms, not the slogan.
choose.p: Replacement guarantees range from a few weeks to multiple years. Read what triggers a refund or a free replacement, and whether layoffs or role changes void it.

choose.h: Check conversion fees before day one.
choose.p: If a temp might become permanent, ask how many worked hours remove the conversion fee. Texas employers often lose money here simply because nobody asked.

firms.name: Frontline Source Group
firms.model: Contract, contract-to-hire, direct hire and executive search
firms.bestFor: Office, finance and IT hires backed by a long guarantee
firms.summary: Frontline was founded in Dallas in 2004, and its Dallas recruiting office sits at 4245 North Central Expressway. Its recruiters each cover one vertical, spanning accounting, finance, technology, legal, administrative, HR, energy and C-suite searches. The firm backs every direct hire with what it calls a 5-Year Placement Warranty and publishes an agency pricing page on its own site, which is rare in this market.
good: You want pricing on paper before the first call
You need several Dallas area offices, including Addison, Frisco, Garland, Irving and Plano
watch: Read what the warranty actually covers and what voids it
Meetings are by appointment only, so walk-in recruiting events are not an option

firms.name: Choice Specialists
firms.model: Direct hire, temp-to-hire, temporary staffing and payrolling
firms.bestFor: Texas employers who want a local, employee-owned firm
firms.summary: Choice Specialists is the Dallas brand of Burnett Specialists, a certified woman-owned business since 1997 that calls itself the largest employee-owned staffing firm in Texas. The Dallas office sits at 1341 W Mockingbird Lane and offers direct-hire placement, temp-to-hire, temporary and contract staffing, and payrolling for workers you have already found. The firm stresses that its recruitment specialists are long tenured.
good: You want to payroll a known contractor without putting them on your own books
Admin, accounting, legal support and IT roles that need a local recruiter
watch: Ask whether a Dallas recruiter or a statewide team will run your search
Confirm which office owns your order if you also hire in Houston

firms.name: Robert Half
firms.model: Contract, full-time placement and executive search
firms.hq: Noel Rd, Dallas and W Plano Pkwy, Plano
firms.bestFor: Accounting and finance teams that need a contractor this week
firms.summary: Robert Half says it pioneered specialized staffing in 1948, and it is listed on the New York Stock Exchange. In the metroplex it runs offices at 13727 Noel Road in Dallas and 6275 West Plano Parkway in Plano, plus an office in Fort Worth. Its local teams place finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support talent on contract, project or full-time terms.
good: An accountant or analyst has to start Monday
You want one vendor across several professional job families
watch: Contract bill rates reflect the brand; ask for the markup on each role
Your account may sit with a different practice team per job family

firms.name: Beacon Hill
firms.model: Staff augmentation, contract to hire, direct hire, executive search
firms.bestFor: Mid-level professional roles split by specialist division
firms.summary: Beacon Hill's Dallas office at 14841 North Dallas Parkway houses four of its divisions: Associates for administrative and professional roles, Financial, Legal and Technologies. The parent group, Beacon Hill Solutions Group, describes itself as one of the largest workforce and business solutions companies in the world, and it also runs HR, life sciences and government services divisions elsewhere.
good: You hire legal and finance support as well as tech
You like a dedicated division team rather than a generalist desk
watch: HR and life sciences divisions are not listed at the Dallas office
Meetings at this location are scheduled by appointment

firms.name: Addison Group
firms.model: Staffing, direct hire and consulting
firms.bestFor: Finance, IT and HR hiring with a Fort Worth office as backup
firms.summary: Addison Group lists its Dallas office at 13760 Noel Road, Suite 800, and a second North Texas office downtown on Commerce Street in Fort Worth. Its practice areas are finance and accounting, information technology, human resources, healthcare, administrative and digital marketing, and the group also sells consulting through sister brands.
good: You hire across Dallas and Fort Worth and want one agreement
Healthcare administration and corporate roles in the same budget
watch: Ask whether a consulting brand or the staffing team will run your order
Senior searches may route to a national practice team rather than the local office

firms.name: Vaco
firms.model: Contract, direct hire and temp-to-hire
firms.bestFor: Finance transformation and tech projects that need interim talent
firms.summary: Vaco's North Texas team works from 2500 Dallas Parkway in Plano. Vaco is now the talent solutions division of Highspring, a professional services group that also sells consulting and managed services. Locally it covers accounting and finance, technology and digital, and HR and operations through contract, direct hire and temp-to-hire arrangements.
good: You need an interim controller or a project team, not only a single hire
You may want consulting help alongside the people
watch: Check whether the quote comes from Vaco staffing or Highspring consulting
The Plano office serves Dallas; ask about on-site meetings in the city

firms.name: LaSalle Network
firms.model: Temporary staffing and direct hire search
firms.bestFor: Technology hires in DFW, plus seasonal temporary teams
firms.summary: LaSalle Network's Dallas page lists an office at 7250 Dallas Parkway in Plano and leads with technology recruiting: product and engineering, cybersecurity, data and analytics, PMO, enterprise systems, and infrastructure and cloud, on direct hire or contract terms. Across the firm it also staffs accounting and finance, healthcare, HR, marketing, sales, supply chain, engineering and administrative roles.
good: A cybersecurity or data role has sat open for a quarter
You need a temporary team for a busy season every year
watch: The Dallas team is tech heavy; confirm who covers other job families
Ask how many open roles each recruiter carries

firms.name: TEKsystems
firms.model: Technology staffing and IT services
firms.hq: N O'Connor, Irving and Dallas Pkwy, Plano
firms.bestFor: Large IT contract programs
firms.summary: TEKsystems runs two North Texas offices: 5205 North O'Connor in Irving and 2400 Dallas Parkway in Plano. It is part of Allegis Group, which its own site describes as a $14.5 billion network of companies. TEKsystems sells both technology talent and delivered IT services, so a buyer can start with contractors and move to a managed project.
good: You need many IT contractors at once
You want the option to turn staff augmentation into a fixed scope project
watch: Small single role orders may get less senior attention
Clarify whether a sister Allegis company will also submit candidates

firms.name: Medix
firms.model: Healthcare, life sciences and locum tenens staffing
firms.bestFor: Clinics and health systems hiring clinical and revenue cycle staff
firms.summary: Medix lists its Dallas office at 5601 Executive Drive in Irving. The firm places physicians, advanced practice providers, allied and nursing clinicians, and specialists in revenue cycle, insurance and care management, and it builds teams for life sciences clients across the development lifecycle. It recently added locum tenens.
good: You hire both clinical and back office healthcare staff
A life sciences team needs contract specialists
watch: Locum tenens is new for the firm; ask for local references
Compare per diem nurse coverage against our nursing staffing guide

firms.name: Snelling
firms.model: Light industrial, clerical and professional staffing
firms.bestFor: Warehouse, manufacturing and call center volume
firms.summary: Snelling's Dallas office is at 400 South Zang Boulevard, with sister offices in Garland on the LBJ Freeway and in Arlington. The team covers light industrial and manufacturing, clerical and administrative, customer service and call center, logistics and distribution, skilled trades, and professional and executive staffing.
good: You need a dozen hourly workers for a distribution shift
You want an office close to Oak Lawn, Garland or Arlington job sites
watch: Ask about safety training and who carries workers' comp
Professional searches are a smaller part of the local business

inhouse.h: When Dallas employers should recruit directly
p: The metroplex has one of the deepest professional labor pools in the country, which cuts both ways: candidates are plentiful, but so are competing offers. If you place the same accountant or developer profile through an agency every quarter, those fees would usually fund an internal recruiter within a year.

A lean internal setup needs three things: an applicant tracking system that keeps past applicants searchable, a scheduling tool that books interviews within a day, and a way to reach passive candidates. Our staffing agency stack shows what agencies themselves run, and the applicant tracking systems category compares the record keeping layer.

Ask every shortlisted firm the same two questions: what is the bill rate for a contract staff accountant for twelve weeks, and what is the placement fee for a permanent one at your salary band. Firms that answer quickly have the market data; firms that need a week are probably building a quote from scratch.

For light industrial and call center work, ask for the pay rate and the markup separately, and confirm who handles drug screening and background checks. Our background check category covers the vendors agencies typically use.

faq.q: Which staffing agency in Dallas is best for temporary office work?
faq.a: For clerical and administrative temps, Choice Specialists, Robert Half and Snelling all list administrative staffing from Dallas offices. Ask each for its fill time on a one week assignment.

faq.q: Do Plano and Irving offices count as Dallas agencies?
faq.a: For most hiring, yes. Plano and Irving are inside the Dallas metro, and several national firms run their North Texas teams from there.

faq.q: How much do Dallas staffing agencies charge?
faq.a: Contract roles are billed as an hourly rate that includes the worker's pay plus a markup; permanent placements are usually a percentage of first year salary. Rates vary by role, so request written quotes.

faq.q: Can my firm be added to this list?
faq.a: Yes. Use the listing details below; we check every firm's Dallas office before adding it.

faq.q: Is there a Dallas agency that offers payrolling?
faq.a: Choice Specialists lists payrolling services, which lets you put a worker you found yourself on the agency's payroll.

h1: Staffing and recruiting firms: 10 national names and the hiring problem each one solves
seoTitle: Staffing and Recruiting Firms: 10 National Firms Compared (2026)
description: Ten U.S. staffing and recruiting firms compared by model: specialized contract staffing, IT consulting, franchised local offices, same-day labor and executive search, with headquarters and what to ask each.
lead: How many staffing firms does a mid-sized employer actually need? Usually two or three, each matched to a different kind of hire. The ten firms below are all national, all still independent brands under the parents named here as of November 2026, and all verified on their own websites this week. They are grouped by what they are built to do, not by revenue, because a firm that fills forklift shifts by the morning is a poor choice for a controller search and the reverse is just as true.
shortAnswer: Short answer: for specialized contract and permanent hires in finance, technology, legal and administration, start with Robert Half. For IT contractors at volume, call Insight Global or Kforce. For locally owned offices in smaller markets, Express Employment Professionals. For same-day industrial and event labor, PeopleReady.

choose.h: Decide whether you are buying hours or a hire.
choose.p: Contract staffing bills an hourly markup for as long as the person works for you; direct hire charges a one-time fee, usually a share of first-year salary. Many firms on this list do both, but most have a center of gravity, and the recruiters you meet will be trained on that side of the business.

choose.h: Match the firm's specialty to the job family.
choose.p: A generalist branch can fill a receptionist role in a day, but a SOX auditor or a Kubernetes engineer needs a recruiter who works that niche every week. Ask how many people in that exact job family the local team placed in the last quarter.

choose.h: Ask who owns the candidate relationship.
choose.p: Franchised networks are run by local owners, so service quality varies by office. Company-owned branches follow one playbook. Neither is better, but you should know which you are signing with before you negotiate terms.

choose.h: Get the conversion terms in writing.
choose.p: If you may hire a contractor permanently, agree the conversion fee and the hours after which it drops before the first person starts. This is the clause most often disputed later.

firms.name: Robert Half
firms.model: Specialized contract, permanent placement, executive search
firms.hq: Offices across the U.S. and abroad (NYSE: RHI)
firms.bestFor: Professional roles in finance, accounting, technology, marketing, legal and admin
firms.summary: Robert Half says it pioneered specialized staffing in 1948 and calls itself the world's largest specialized talent solutions and business consulting firm. It recruits for contract and full-time roles and runs executive search, with specialties in finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative support.
good: You need a temporary accountant or analyst this week and may convert them later
You want one supplier across several professional job families
watch: Markups on specialized contract talent sit above generalist rates, so compare on total cost per filled hour
Ask whether your search is handled locally or by a remote practice team

firms.model: Temporary, temp-to-hire and permanent staffing across many industries
firms.bestFor: Employers who want one national supplier for operational and professional roles
firms.summary: Randstad USA lists its registered office at One Overton Park in Atlanta and is part of the Netherlands-based Randstad N.V. group. Its U.S. site covers operational work (customer service, industrial, manufacturing and logistics, skilled trades) alongside professional lines such as engineering, finance and accounting, healthcare, HR and legal, life sciences, and sales and marketing, plus a high volume solutions offering.
good: You run both warehouse and office hiring and want a single contract
You need high volume hiring for a seasonal ramp
watch: A firm this broad assigns your account to a specific division; meet that team, not only the sales lead
Confirm which branch will actually source candidates for your site

firms.name: Kelly
firms.model: Temporary staffing, direct hire, MSP and RPO
firms.bestFor: Large employers that want staffing plus a managed service program
firms.summary: Kelly says it opened in Detroit in 1946 and now lists its headquarters at 999 West Big Beaver Road in Troy, Michigan, with operations in about 80 countries. Beyond temporary and direct hire staffing it offers managed service provider and recruitment process outsourcing programs, and it runs specialty units for education, engineering, science and clinical, government, and professional and industrial work, plus the Motion Recruitment and Softworld technology brands.
good: You want one partner to manage all your contingent suppliers
You staff substitute teachers or clinical research roles
watch: Under an MSP, ask how Kelly treats competing agencies in the order flow
Specialty units run somewhat separately, so references should come from the unit you will use

firms.name: Insight Global
firms.model: IT and professional staffing, direct placement, RPO, consulting
firms.bestFor: Technology contractors at speed and scale
firms.summary: Insight Global has operated since 2001, lists its corporate office on Hammond Drive in Atlanta and describes itself as the second largest IT staffing company in the U.S. It reports more than 70 offices across 35 states, Washington DC, Canada, the UK, India and the Philippines. Services run from contract staffing and direct placement to executive search, recruitment process outsourcing and a consulting arm.
good: You need several developers, analysts or help desk staff on short notice
You want offshore and onshore contractors from one supplier
watch: Speed is the selling point, so screen submissions yourself before interviews
Ask how many of the submitted candidates were already in their database versus newly sourced

firms.name: Kforce
firms.model: Technology and finance and accounting staffing, contract and direct hire
firms.bestFor: Mid-sized and enterprise teams hiring technology and finance professionals
firms.summary: Kforce lists its corporate headquarters at 1150 Assembly Drive in Tampa, Florida, and focuses on technology and finance and accounting talent placed on a temporary or direct-hire basis. The firm cites more than 60 years in business, roughly 1,800 clients and about 17,000 consultants on assignment.
good: You want a firm narrower than a generalist but with national reach
You hire contractors in both IT and accounting
watch: Its focus is professional work, so look elsewhere for light industrial
Request the ratio of contract to direct-hire placements in your city

firms.bestFor: Employers in smaller metros who want a locally owned office

good: You want an owner who lives in your town and answers the phone
You hire across production, office and skilled roles locally
watch: Each franchise sets much of its own practice, so get references from your specific office
Multi-state employers may deal with several separate owners

firms.bestFor: Specialist professional roles where a dedicated division matters
firms.summary: Beacon Hill lists its corporate headquarters at 20 Ashburton Place in Boston and runs separate divisions for administrative associates, financial, government services, HR, legal, life sciences and technologies. good: You hire paralegals, clinical research staff or HR generalists and want a specialist desk
You prefer a privately held firm with division-level focus
watch: Coverage is strongest in its established metros; ask about remote placement elsewhere

firms.summary: Addison Group lists its headquarters at 225 West Randolph Street in Chicago and staffs finance and accounting, information technology, human resources, non-clinical healthcare, administrative and digital marketing roles. watch: Clarify whether a project is billed as staffing or as consulting, since terms differ
Ask which offices hold recruiters for your job family

The Vaco site lists more than 45 offices and seven international delivery centers, with talent solutions in accounting and finance, HR and operations, and technology.
good: You need contract finance staff during a system migration or audit
You may also want transaction or IPO readiness help from the parent
watch: The rebrand means older contracts may name a different entity; check before renewing
Confirm whether your account sits with Vaco or another Highspring brand

firms.name: PeopleReady
firms.model: Same-day and on-demand industrial staffing, temp-to-hire
firms.hq: 400+ branches in all 50 states and Puerto Rico
firms.bestFor: General labor, events, warehouse and construction shifts

p: Agencies earn their fee when speed or volume beats everything else. For steady, repeatable hiring, such as the same sales or support role every quarter, a recruiter on payroll who owns a warm pipeline will usually cost less within a year than paying a placement fee on every hire.

The cost gap has narrowed further because sourcing software now does much of the research an agency recruiter used to bill for. A team can run AI sourcing tools such as Noon to find matching people across the open web and reach them by email and SMS, then hand only the roles that need a specialist's network to an outside firm. Our staffing agency tool stack lists the software most firms on this page also use.

sections.h: What a fair markup looks like
p: Contract pricing is quoted as a bill rate: the worker's pay rate plus the firm's markup, which covers payroll taxes, workers' compensation, benefits, recruiting and margin. Light industrial markups are typically lower than specialized professional ones because the recruiting effort per hire is smaller.

Ask each shortlisted firm to price the same scenario in writing, for example one staff accountant for 12 weeks at a stated pay rate, and compare the totals. A lower markup with a high conversion fee can cost more than a higher markup with free conversion after 520 hours.

In practice the terms overlap. Staffing firms place workers who stay on the agency's payroll; recruiting firms place people directly onto yours. Most of the firms above do both. Pure retained search boutiques, which charge in stages for senior hires, sit outside this list; our nursing staffing agencies page shows how a single-industry list differs.

faq.q: What is the difference between a staffing firm and a recruiting firm?
faq.a: A staffing firm employs the worker and bills you by the hour while they are on assignment. A recruiting firm finds a candidate you hire directly and charges a one-time fee. Most large firms, including all ten on this list, offer both.

faq.q: Which staffing firm is best for IT contractors?
faq.a: Insight Global and Kforce are built around technology contractors, and Robert Half and Beacon Hill run dedicated technology practices. Ask each for recent placements in your exact stack.

faq.q: Are franchised staffing offices worse than company-owned ones?
faq.a: Not necessarily. A franchise such as an Express office is run by a local owner, which can mean faster decisions and closer relationships, but quality varies more from office to office. Always take references from the specific branch.

faq.q: How many staffing firms should one company use?
faq.a: Two or three is common for a mid-sized employer: one for hourly or industrial work, one for professional contract roles, and possibly a specialist for a hard job family. More than that is usually managed through an MSP.

inhouse.h: When San Antonio employers should recruit directly
p: San Antonio's labor pool includes a large veteran population, steady graduates from UTSA and Trinity, and a growing technology workforce around cybersecurity. Employers who hire the same profile every quarter, whether billing specialists or security analysts, often find that agency fees would fund an internal recruiter within a year.

A lean in-house setup needs an applicant tracking system that keeps past applicants searchable, a scheduling tool that books interviews quickly, and a way to reach passive candidates. Our stack for scaling companies covers the basics, and the sourcing tools category compares options for finding people who are not applying, including AI sourcers such as Noon that contact candidates by email and SMS.

sections.h: What San Antonio fees usually look like
p: Request two quotes from every finalist: a bill rate for a twelve-week contract staff accountant and a placement fee for the same role hired permanently at your salary band. Firms that know the local market answer within a day.

For labor and light industrial orders, compare the hourly pay rate, the markup and any minimum shift length. Background screening is often billed separately; our background check category lists the providers agencies commonly use.

We started with firms that publish a San Antonio street address on their own website, opened each location page in November 2026, and removed any brand whose San Antonio page redirected or no longer listed an office.
